status: Prospective engineering gate, not an accuracy experiment

prior_work.integration: Unchanged author Linear implements each low-rank residual. Regional mixing and native hooks are project adaptations, not a published LoRA VOS result.

method: One native dense read; four layer-specific, content-dependent residual transforms mixed by three continuous memberships from each stored prediction. All native frames, spatial tokens, temporal positions and pointers retained. No confidence gate, added threshold or query-mask second pass.
control: Same parameters and initialization; broadcast each stored frame's mean memberships to its tokens.
checks: Zero initialization reproduces native masks, object scores and intermediate autoregressive memory writes bit-for-bit.
Every read visits all four layers once and regional/global key and pointer schedules match.
Every LoRA B receives finite nonzero gradients initially; both factors receive finite nonzero gradients after the first update.
All native weights remain frozen and their digest is unchanged.
Post-update propagation is finite; saved-source hashes remain unchanged.
scope: Training-only clip; no validation-based choice, no Dice improvement claim. DAVIS requires a separate instance-aware integration and baseline-reproduction gate.
